# Specification-Driven Coding — Score Output

Evaluate the final output against spec, blueprint, plan and tasks.

Use a 0–100 score with evidence for:
- spec adherence;
- domain specificity;
- architecture;
- security/privacy;
- UX/accessibility;
- performance/reliability;
- testability;
- maintainability;
- assumptions/risks.

If tests were not executed, reduce the score and state the limitation.
